indexes.confirmed_station: CREATE INDEX confirmed_station ON bookings(station_id,slot,total_cents) WHERE status='confirmed'

queries.customer:
SELECT id,slot,total_cents,status FROM bookings WHERE customer_id=?
 ORDER BY slot DESC,id DESC LIMIT 20
queries.station:
SELECT COUNT(*),SUM(total_cents),SUM(energy_wh) FROM bookings
 WHERE station_id=? AND slot>=? AND slot<?
queries.confirmed:
SELECT COUNT(*),SUM(total_cents) FROM bookings
 WHERE station_id=? AND status='confirmed' AND slot>=? AND slot<?
queries.status:
SELECT id,slot,station_id,total_cents FROM bookings
 WHERE status=? AND slot>=? AND slot<? ORDER BY slot,id LIMIT 80
queries.daily:
SELECT slot/24 AS day,COUNT(*),SUM(total_cents) FROM bookings
 WHERE slot>=? AND slot<? GROUP BY day ORDER BY day
queries.city:
SELECT s.city,COUNT(*),SUM(b.total_cents) FROM stations AS s
 JOIN bookings AS b ON b.station_id=s.id
 WHERE s.city=? AND b.slot>=? AND b.slot<? AND b.status='confirmed'
 GROUP BY s.city ORDER BY s.city

timing: perf_counter_ns around execute+fetchall only for per-query latencies; hashes outside timing. Batch throughput includes the sequential execute/fetch/Python loop, checks after timing. Warmup excludes initial runs; no cold disk/cache claim.
planner: SQLite default cost planner with automatic_index=ON and full ANALYZE for every portfolio; no INDEXED BY hints or manual join-order forcing.
storage: Budget limits selected index B-tree bytes from dbstat, in exact KiB units; total DB bytes and build/analyze costs reported separately. Data/primary keys/statistics are not charged to the discretionary index budget.
evaluation: Two training parameter sets per family select indexes. Three held-out sets per family evaluate generalization. Matched deterministic query orders per repeat; fresh connection per portfolio/repeat; OS caches warm, pager cache 8 MiB. Unique portfolios timed once and shared by method labels.
